description: Get the legacy User Reports and crash-report feedback attached to a Sentry issue: what users said happened. For User Feedback widget submissions, use search_issues.

anyOf.description: Cursor from the previous page of this issue.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: get_issue_user_reports

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor with the same issue scope for the next page.

email.description: Email on the report, falling back to the event user.

name.description: Name the reporter entered, falling back to the event user's name. Null when Sentry only has an email or username.
Null when Sentry only has an email or username.

user.description: The user on the linked event. Null when the event has none.

title: Get Issue User Reports
